versions.changelog: 修复：新增 notifications_triggers / notifications_deliveries / notifications_deliveries_clear 三个工具（API 已支持但 MCP 工具缺失）；修复 notifications_triggers 结果字段解析错误（data.triggers 而非 data.items）；版本号 55→58

fn-knock-mcp 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Manage fn-knock gateway via its admin API with over 55 structured tools
- Supports reverse proxy, DDNS, SSL/ACME, tunnels, scanner features, whitelist, and more
- Flexible HMAC secret setup: environment variable, credentials file, or auto-detection from local instance
- Easy integration with OpenClaw MCP for streamlined management
- Detailed troubleshooting and installation instructions included
